reason: The full arXiv text describes MuGCP: an MLLM acts as conditional prompt learner, cached key/value states supply instance prompts, and experiments cover 14 vision-language datasets. It avoids fine-tuning large MLLMs, but its contribution is few-shot VLM classification/prompting rather than LLM inference serving or KV-cache reduction; the lineage connection is weak.
title: Multi-modal mutual-guidance conditional prompt learning for vision-language models
